lines: MrBeast once spent forty hours... just counting.
He sat in front of a camera, and counted all the way to one hundred thousand.
It sounds like the dumbest YouTube idea imaginable. But there was something genius about it.
Because you understand the entire video — before you even click it.
And that's the trick MrBeast would eventually master. Take something ridiculously simple, and push it to an extreme.
Counting became bigger challenges. Bigger challenges became bigger videos. And bigger videos built MrBeast.
The lesson isn't: do something stupid. It's this. Make the idea impossible to ignore.
Because before the algorithm can make you viral... a human still has to click.
